note: Set A correctly captures three of the page's key text facts — the note that all current-carrying cable is USE-2, 10 G.A, the ENMA 3R junction box on the side of the house, and the PV array's connection to planter equipment (see E-206) — whereas Set B omits the junction box and planter connection and garbles the cable note by dropping "USE-" from the value. Set B does capture the frameless glass design (see E-502) that A misses, and it binds the repeated "3" annotation more consistently as quantity/module count. A's errors are the misbound "3" annotations ("contains component", "associated component", "connection"), attributing the cable-tie U.V. rating to current-carrying cable, and a vague "PV Array/String" type for SA1-5; B's are three misbound "voltage 3" claims, an "associated component 3", the mangled cable spec, and a vague "next array component" connection. Both truncate the module model to "SUNPREME GX2" (text reads GX290), but on balance A preserves more of the page's substantive, correctly bound facts.
